as_told.title: Eric Hecker's South Pole neutrino emitters claim

plain: This story is about IceCube, a large science station at the South Pole in Antarctica that is built to detect neutrinos, tiny particles that pass through almost everything. A man named Eric Hecker says it can also send energy out, not just take it in. Jay Anderson, a guest on Jesse Michels' podcast, says Hecker found documents suggesting it is a two-way device that can emit energy, and the story calls it an "earthquake gun." Michels himself retells it simply as Hecker's claim that there are neutrino detectors and emitters at the South Pole. If true, a science station would really be hiding a weapon.
